description: Developed the company site, built the backend using nodejs, express js and mongoDB for storing student data. Used nodemailer to send user data via mail to the admin and send a thank you mail to registered user.
Developed a registration and login form. Used MongoDB to stored user data(email and hashed password). This solution is aimed at solving accomodation issues.
Developed a pixel perfect responsive site for a tech company showcasing the various courses they offer using nextjs, typescript and tailwind.
